## Endpoints

### GET /books

List books. Filters are exact matches.

**Query parameters**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum: available, checked_out | no | Filter by lending status |
| `author` | string | no | Filter by author |
| `title` | string | no | Filter by title |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max items to return |
| `offset` | integer | no | Items to skip |

### GET /books/{book_id}

Fetch one book.

**Path parameters**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `book_id` | integer | yes |  |

### POST /books

Add a book to the catalog. New books start as available.

**JSON body**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `author` | string | yes |  |

### PATCH /books/{book_id}

Update a book's title or author.

**Path parameters**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `book_id` | integer | yes |  |

**JSON body**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | no |  |
| `author` | string | no |  |

### POST /book/{book_id}/checkout

Check a book out to a member. The book must be available.

**Path parameters**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `book_id` | integer | yes |  |

**JSON body**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `member_id` | integer | yes | The borrowing member |

### POST /books/{book_id}/return

Return a checked-out book.

**Path parameters**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `book_id` | integer | yes |  |

| name | type | required | description |
